The operator of this facility cannot be identified. A reverse geocode of the published coordinates returns a different current occupant, TraVek Inc in Scottsdale, and the registry's search tool is exhausted. No specifications for power, cooling, or IT capacity are available.

Without published power figures, the campus cannot be assessed for AI hosting density or growth trajectory. Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities, but only 4 publish power specifications, totaling 512 MW. This facility's ranking by published MW is fifth in state, but that ranking reflects no actual published figure from the operator.

Any assessment of whether this campus matters to AI infrastructure requires operator identity and capacity specs that are not available in the published record. Manual research or direct contact with current occupants would be required to determine current use and capability.
